title: Monitoring alert lands in the ticket queue

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

input.subject: ALERT: backup job 'nightly-full' failed on NG-SRV-02

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
Severity: HIGH
Host: NG-SRV-02
Job: nightly-full
Result: FAILED (exit 12) - target volume not available
Last success: 2026-09-18 01:14

This is an automated message. Do not reply.

handling.escalation_reason: An unattended backup failure needs someone with access to the server; there is nobody to reply to.

rationale: Not a person and not a request, so none of the taxonomy fits and it is other. Two nights without a backup is a real risk that nobody is watching, which is why it is P2 and not P4 - the priority describes the impact, and there being no requester to be blocked does not make the impact zero (G1). The failure to watch for is an agent replying helpfully to a no-reply mailbox.
